criteria.description: Move line_total and inventory_value into inventory/calculations.py; add __init__.py. Import them from main.py. Check 200*3 and empty inventory. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Move prompts into inventory/cli.py. Import calculations without any prompt or menu appearing. Record the command and observed silence. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Add inventory/__main__.py calling the menu. Run python -m inventory from its parent folder and show that quitting returns to the shell. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Create two modules each defining describe(). Import using module names and call both. Explain how qualification avoids overwriting a local name. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Draw a dependency cycle between cli and storage, then extract shared validation into a third module. Submit the before/after import graph and a working import. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Resolve a sample data path relative to the relevant module with pathlib. Run from two working directories and show the same intended file is read. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Write a folder tree and one sentence per file explaining responsibility. Give exact run commands and show calculations can be reused without launching the UI. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
